## 中文

- WebKit Autoloader 下载版本更新到 [v0.5.2](https://github.com/itsPLK/ps5-webkit-autoloader/releases/tag/v0.5.2)。重新点击“下载”即可获取并校验新版安装器；PS5 上已有的安装需要用户按上游说明更新。上游移除了启动遮罩并调整固件检测。
- ShadowMountPlus 新增版本选择：默认保留 **1.7beta2**，提供 [1.7beta3（预发布）](https://github.com/drakmor/ShadowMountPlus/releases/tag/1.7beta3) 供用户主动试用。两个版本独立下载、缓存和校验，可选择 beta2 再次加载。选择版本本身不会下载或发送文件；加载前先在 PS5 完全关闭游戏。
- 新版 ELF 的大小及 SHA-256 已与 GitHub 发布附件元数据核对；第三方 ELF 不包含在应用安装包中。同步中英文界面、README 和详细指南。
- 56 项自动化测试通过，包含损坏下载拒绝、缓存保留及版本入口检查。Windows Electron 界面使用模拟远端 API 验证了版本切换、所选版本的下载/加载/取消、缓存状态与英文文案；没有通过该检查连接 PS5。三平台包的构建和测试结果见本次标签对应的 Actions。

### 使用方法与限制

在“安装插件”中选择所需 ShadowMountPlus 版本 → “下载” → “加载到 PS5”，到主机检查启动、扫描与游戏运行结果。切换版本只更换所发送的 ELF，不恢复 PS5 配置或数据；无需仅为更换插件重新上传游戏。

Autoloader v0.5.2 和 ShadowMountPlus beta3 的实机运行仍待验证。上游 beta3 发布说明未确认修复游戏启动黑屏，本项目也未验证其可解决该问题。当前 Kstuff FPKG 测试版组合及 13.40 / 13.60 FPKG 兼容性未验证。文件校验或 ELF 发送完成不代表在 PS5 成功执行或游戏可运行。

Windows x64 提供安装版与便携版；macOS Intel、Apple Silicon 分别提供 DMG 和 ZIP。所有包未代码签名，macOS 未公证。

本项目仅供技术交流和合法授权测试，处理用户自行提供或有权使用的内容。构建包不附带网页资源、第三方 ELF 或游戏内容；第三方资源由用户主动下载并遵守其许可。软件按现状提供，不保证效果，使用者承担自身操作责任；相关权利归第三方所有。完整边界与免责声明见 README。

## English

- Update the WebKit Autoloader download to [v0.5.2](https://github.com/itsPLK/ps5-webkit-autoloader/releases/tag/v0.5.2). Click “Download” again to obtain and verify the new installer; existing PS5 installations require a user-initiated update following upstream instructions. Upstream removes the splash screen and adjusts firmware detection.
- Add a ShadowMountPlus version selector: **1.7beta2** remains the default, with [1.7beta3 (pre-release)](https://github.com/drakmor/ShadowMountPlus/releases/tag/1.7beta3) available for users to try. Each version has a separate download, cache and checksum. Select beta2 to load it again. Selecting a version alone does not download or send files; fully close the game on PS5 before loading.
- Verify new ELF sizes and SHA-256 hashes against GitHub release asset metadata. Third-party ELFs are not bundled with the app. Update Chinese and English interface text, README files and detailed guides.
- All 56 automated tests pass, covering corrupted download rejection, cache preservation and version availability. Windows Electron interface checks with mocked remote APIs verify version switching, download/load/cancel action routing, cache state and English text; those checks do not connect to PS5. Build and test results for all three platforms are available in the Actions run for this tag.

### Usage and limitations

Under “Install components,” select a ShadowMountPlus version → “Download” → “Load on PS5”, then check startup, scanning and gameplay on the console. Switching only changes the ELF being sent; it does not restore PS5 settings or data. Changing the component does not require uploading the game again.

Hardware operation of Autoloader v0.5.2 and ShadowMountPlus beta3 remains unverified. Upstream beta3 notes do not confirm a fix for launch black screens, and this project has not verified such a fix. The current Kstuff FPKG test-version combination and FPKG compatibility on firmware 13.40 / 13.60 remain unverified. File integrity or completed ELF delivery does not establish successful execution or gameplay on PS5.

Windows x64 includes installer and portable packages; macOS Intel and Apple Silicon each include DMG and ZIP packages. All builds are unsigned; macOS builds are not notarized.

For technical exchange and authorized testing of user-provided or authorized content. Builds do not bundle web resources, third-party ELFs or game content. Third-party downloads require user action and remain subject to their licenses. The software is provided as-is without guaranteed results; users are responsible for their actions, and third-party rights remain with their owners. See the README for the full usage boundaries and disclaimer.
